query: Review todo_list.dart in this directory. It is a screen from our Riverpod app that we are about to ship. Point out what is wrong and show the corrected code.
expected_behavior: States that StateNotifierProvider/StateNotifier and StateProvider are legacy in Riverpod 3 and must not be used in new code

Flags the use of BuildContext (ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)) after an await without a context.mounted guard

query: Our Flutter app uses go_router. I need https://shop.example.com/order/<id> links to open the app straight on the order screen on both Android and iOS. Walk me through everything I have to change.
expected_behavior: Defines the route as a go_router GoRoute with a path parameter and reads it from state.pathParameters
Gives the Android side: an intent-filter with android:autoVerify="true" plus a BROWSABLE/DEFAULT VIEW action and https scheme with the host in AndroidManifest.xml
Names the Android Digital Asset Links file /.well-known/assetlinks.json hosted on the domain, with the app's SHA-256 signing fingerprint
Gives the iOS side: an apple-app-site-association file at /.well-known/ on the domain plus the Associated Domains capability with applinks:shop.example.com
Gives a concrete command to test the link on a device or simulator (adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW ... or xcrun simctl openurl)

query: Add tests for weather_repository.dart in this directory. Cover the success path and the failure path.
expected_behavior: Stubs the HTTP boundary without code generation - mocktail, or the MockClient handler from package:http/testing - and does not pull in mockito plus build_runner; if mocktail's any() is used on a Uri, registers a fallback value in setUpAll

Names flutter test (or dart test) as the command that must pass, and flutter analyze as the second gate
